description: Browse, filter and visualize Classic Workflows and Power Automate flows from the Dataverse workflow table as interactive process maps (XAML for workflows, JSON for flows). Collapse and expand scopes, loops and conditions to tame large flows; click any step to inspect its full inputs, expressions and pretty-printed fetchXml; send queries straight to FetchXML Builder. Export a single process to PDF, HTML, SVG (Visio/Mural compatible), PNG or Markdown, or generate a browsable HTML documentation pack or a Markdown knowledge pack for Copilot Studio (and other AI knowledge bases) for every process with one click.
releaseNotes: 1.0.33: The map is visible again next to the process list - the list opened at about four fifths of the window and could leave the map with no room; it now opens at 320 px, keeps that width as the window is resized and gives way only when the window is too narrow. Dates in flow definitions are shown exactly as written instead of converted to local time. Secrets typed into HTTP and connector actions (Authorization and API-key headers, keys and tokens in URLs and query parameters, passwords and client secrets in request bodies and authentication settings) are shown as (hidden) in the details pane and every export; expressions that only refer to a secret stay visible. Fixed: a diagonal connector drawn across a frame in the nested layout; loop and retry lines running through steps; a failed preview leaving the previous process on screen and exportable; a preview on one tab cancelling a preview still loading on the other; switching the Nested layout button while a map was being built; an error when the tool was closed during a load or export; Esc not leaving full screen after the Full screen button was clicked; PNG export of very long maps (now scaled to fit, or a clear message when too large); PDF pages beyond the PDF size limit (now scaled to fit one page); a process named Index overwritten by the bulk export index; bulk exports losing their index when a name was cut in the middle of an emoji; processes named CON, NUL and the like, or with no name, in bulk exports; emoji cut in half in shortened labels; control characters making SVG files unreadable; Markdown links, headings and code broken by brackets, # or backticks in names and expressions; dates in exports and the process list written in the user's calendar rather than the Gregorian one; two actions whose names differ only in case, and a Switch without cases, in hand-edited flows; Flowchart workflows authored outside the Dataverse designer, which lost branches and steps. 1.0.32: Fixed processes not appearing after changing the connection. The list now reloads from the new environment by itself, a name typed in the filter box for the previous environment no longer hides the new one's processes, a load clicked while XrmToolBox was still connecting is redone on the new environment, results still arriving from the previous environment are discarded, and full screen is left so the list is visible. A load that finds nothing now says "0 flows" instead of "Not loaded". Export All always exports from the environment the list came from. 1.0.31: Large maps open partly collapsed so they read at a glance - expand any container, or use Expand all - while exports (PDF, SVG, PNG, HTML) always contain every step, whatever is collapsed on screen. Step counts now count real steps only. The Markdown export lists every group of steps that run at the same time, including groups inside another group's branches. Fewer crossing lines in the flat layout. 1.0.30: New nested layout, now the default: each scope, condition, switch case, loop and wait is drawn as a frame around its steps, and the step that runs next is drawn below the frame instead of beside the container's first steps; the "Nested layout" button switches back to the flat layout. Classic workflows are now mapped correctly - previously only their first step appeared - with conditions written out as text, Otherwise-if chains, waits and timeouts, stop-workflow and custom steps. Suspended flows show as Suspended rather than Draft. Faster loading, maps built in the background, smoother panning. 1.0.24-1.0.29: Switch cases drawn as labelled chips using the designer's case titles; empty branches shown explicitly; groups of steps that run in parallel are outlined; new Markdown export and "Export All Markdown" knowledge pack for Copilot Studio. 1.0.23: Trigger details now show Trigger conditions (Settings > Trigger conditions) and Split on, which were previously invisible in the details pane and HTML exports. 1.0.22: Long connectors now route through reserved channels so lines never pass under step boxes; Collapse all / Expand all buttons on the map; intuitive zooming - Ctrl+wheel zooms at the cursor, drag to pan, +/- buttons; HTML exports get an interactive pan/zoom diagram viewer (wheel, drag, Fit/100%); "Find step" box selects, centers and reveals matches; run-after labels read "always" instead of listing all four statuses and every label gets its own line. 1.0.21: Large-map readability overhaul - children now align under their parents, a container's actions stay grouped together, every connector gets its own clean lane (gaps stretch to fit) and overlapping loops get separate rails; click a step to highlight its connections and dim the rest; full-screen mode for the map (button top-right, Esc to exit); automated regression test suite. 1.0.20: Collapsible scopes, loops and conditions in the preview ([+]/[-] on container nodes); send a step's fetchXml straight to FetchXML Builder; copy any detail value; PNG export; bulk "Export All HTML" documentation pack with index page; details now include every input field dynamically; fixed flows failing to render when an action has scalar inputs. 1.0.19: Click a step to see its full inputs in a new details pane (all parameters, wrapped values, pretty-printed fetchXml); HTML export now embeds a crisp vector SVG diagram, a collapsible step tree with per-step details and expand/collapse all; fixed oversized text in exported diagrams and clipped long titles. 1.0.18: Crossing reduction in the layout - child actions are now ordered under their parents so connectors no longer cross. 1.0.17: Orthogonal connectors with lane separation and readable branch labels, fit-to-width auto-scaling preview, SVG export (Visio/Mural compatible), name filter boxes, flow list shows Created On/Created By/Modified By/Owner/Scope. 1.0.15: Add summary and release notes, remove SPDX license element for Tool Library compatibility. 1.0.0: Initial release - two-tab UI for Power Automate flows and classic workflows, GDI+ process maps, PDF and HTML export.
summary: Visualize Dataverse workflows and Power Automate flows as interactive, collapsible process maps with step details and PDF/HTML/SVG/PNG/Markdown export.
title: Dataverse Process Mapper
